deck_title: phaseIdCrossCorrelation: NCC vs Hough-NCC (Curated EBSD Comparison)

slides.title: Objective and Scope
bullets: Goal: improve phase ID among fe_bcc, fe3o4_magnetite, and feo_wustite.
Compare masked image-space NCC vs KikuchiPy Hough-space NCC variants.
Use latest result snapshot: reports/curated_hough_vs_ncc/summary.json (2026-02-21 09:41 UTC).
Primary metric: top-1 phase accuracy on curated experimental patterns.
slides.bottom_line: This comparison targets phase-correctness, not throughput, on curated benchmark evidence.

slides.title: Data and Trial Configuration
bullets: Curated cases: 3 (r001-r003), one experimental pattern per phase.
Each case compares 3 simulated candidates from phase-isolated indexing assumptions.
Hough config: n_theta=180, n_rho=90, n_bands=9, convolved-map=True.
Binary Hough trials sweep tau = 0.35, 0.45, 0.55, 0.65, 0.75.
slides.bottom_line: The experiment is controlled but very small, so conclusions are directional not final.

slides.title: Methodology Pipeline
bullets: Experimental pattern is compared against three phase-conditional simulated patterns.
Common preprocessing: circular mask + minmax normalization inside mask.
Compute image_ncc and hough_ncc scores per candidate; rank by top score.
Decision evidence includes top score, second score, and margin = top-second.
slides.bottom_line: Both branches use identical candidates; only similarity representation differs.

slides.title: Scoring Equations and Decision Rule
bullets: NCC is computed over masked pixels to reduce edge/background bias.
Prediction uses argmax over candidate scores for the 3 phase hypotheses.
Confidence proxy is margin (top score minus runner-up score).
Hough trials evaluate raw map NCC and thresholded binary-map NCC.
slides.bottom_line: Decision quality depends on separability of candidate scores, not just raw score magnitude.

slides.title: Headline Accuracy: NCC vs Hough-NCC
bullets: Image NCC: 1/3 correct (33.3%).
Hough raw NCC: 2/3 correct (66.7%).
Best binary Hough method: hough_ncc_bin_t450 at 2/3 (66.7%).
Absolute gain over image NCC: +33.3 percentage points on curated set.
slides.bottom_line: Latest curated JSON indicates Hough-space scoring improves top-1 phase accuracy.

slides.title: Binary Threshold Trials (Hough NCC)
bullets: Thresholds 0.35, 0.45, and 0.65 each achieve 2/3 accuracy.
Thresholds 0.55 and 0.75 fall to 1/3 accuracy.
Best threshold in latest summary: tau=0.45 with strongest mean margin among 2/3 methods.
Result confirms parameter sensitivity and need for robustness gating.
slides.bottom_line: Tau=0.45 is a provisional best setting, not yet a frozen operating point.

slides.title: Winner Quality Flags and Fallback Impact
bullets: Image NCC winners include failed/fallback orientations in 2 of 3 cases.
Hough raw and hough_bin_t450 reduce failed/fallback winners to 1 of 3.
The unresolved error case (r003) still tracks a failed/fallback bcc winner.
Decision hygiene (penalty + uncertainty gate) is required before scale-up.
slides.bottom_line: Reducing fallback-driven winners is central to reliable phase decisions.

slides.title: Per-Case Outcome Matrix
bullets: r001 (truth bcc): all methods correct.
r002 (truth fe3o4): image NCC fails, Hough raw/bin methods recover correct phase.
r003 (truth feo): all methods predict bcc (persistent failure).
Improvements are real but case-dependent; ambiguity remains on hard sample.
slides.bottom_line: Hough branch fixes one key failure but does not solve all ambiguity cases.

slides.title: Qualitative Evidence: r002 Recovered by Hough
bullets: Ground truth for r002 is fe3o4_magnetite.
Image NCC selects bcc candidate (incorrect).
Hough raw and binary (tau=0.45) select fe3o4 candidate (correct).
Band-structure representation improves discrimination in this magnetite case.
slides.bottom_line: For r002, Hough-space matching corrects the phase label missed by image NCC.

slides.title: Conclusions and Next Steps
bullets: Latest JSON comparison supports Hough-NCC as a stronger branch than image NCC on curated data.
One hard case (r003) remains unresolved; all methods collapse to bcc.
Immediate actions: fallback penalty, uncertainty output, and robustness-gated parameter lock.
Expand curated orientations per phase before declaring default method for scan-wide runs.
slides.bottom_line: Adopt Hough branch in parallel with strict decision guardrails before broader deployment.
